## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector performance (Utilities, Industrials, Financials positive while Tech, Energy and Communication are weak) and major megacap divergences (MSFT BELOW TREND while INTC and chip-equipment names are ABOVE TREND), so no clear directional bias.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +8.58% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND and ETN (1W: +11.34% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND. Financials constructive: COF (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND and SLB (1W: -14.65% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND. Communication Services pressured: CMCSA (1W: -8.90% | 1M: -10.29%) BELOW TREND and NFLX (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND. Technology mixed-to-weak: MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -10.03%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +18.48%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials and Financials participation.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -26.69% | 1M: -30.35%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -14.65% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -13.91% | 1M: -13.19%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.51% | 1M: -16.43%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap software, energy and select communications names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +18.48%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: megacaps AAPL (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -6.52%) RECOVERY and MSFT BELOW TREND — tactical, not regime-confirming.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is mixed: semis and equipment lead (AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND, INTC ABOVE TREND) while large-cap software and internet names are weak (MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.51% | 1M: -16.43%) BELOW TREND). Sector-level 1W: -0.47% across 24 stocks indicates internal rotation rather than broad strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive with pockets of strength: JPM (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND and COF (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND, but CME (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -15.05%) BELOW TREND highlights dispersion. Sector 1W: +1.13% across 20 stocks supports the Value/Cyclical tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare shows mixed/defensive properties: UNH (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +1.44%) CORRECTION and PFE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -2.75%) BELOW TREND signal internal rotation. Watch headlines (AMGN -75 in news) as a downside catalyst despite overall modest 1M strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclical/value exposure: tilt to CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND and COF (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing weakness (MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.51% | 1M: -16.43%) BELOW TREND) and monitor RECOVERY setups in AAPL and NVDA for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND on +80 sentiment and AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND for semis momentum. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND on negative headlines and ACN (1W: -26.69% | 1M: -30.35%) BELOW TREND for continuation risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +6.19%) and Financials (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +5.04%) given leadership. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -8.05%) and Communication (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -6.33%) remain at risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Monitor semis continuation: AMAT/LRCX hold above this week’s highs to confirm sector follow-through (both ABOVE TREND). Watch MSFT weekly breakdown (MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND) for further downside that would reinforce dispersion. Flag AAPL (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -6.52%) RECOVERY for confirmation before treating them as market leaders.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LRCX (+80): LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirm accumulation. CEG (+55): CEG (1W: +8.58% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY — positive headline with short-term bounce, watch follow-through. CVX (+55): CVX (1W: -6.50% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price diverging, monitor for distribution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMGN (-75): heavy negative legal/patent headline (monitor; price not in today’s detailed top/bottom list for confirmation). XOM (-45): XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND — news aligns with price weakness. WFC (-45): regulatory-focused headlines warrant watching for follow-through (WFC not in today’s detailed view for timeframe confirmation).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND and VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major megacap divergence (MSFT BELOW TREND vs. RECOVERY reads in AAPL and NVDA) and energy headlines (XOM BELOW TREND) that could keep the market transitional.
